value.name: leave desk items undisturbed
value.description: The characters leave the desk as it was, with the lamp still on and the blotter showing where the pages had been aligned.
evidence: The lamp was still on behind them, the blotter still bearing the faint rectangle where the two pages had lain aligned

value.name: avoid turning off the light
value.description: No one switches off the study light because leaving the room dark would reveal more to Daniel.
evidence: none of them moved to switch the light off, because a dark study would tell Daniel more than a lit one

value.name: open service door quietly
value.description: Asha opens the service door carefully, using her palm to keep the latch from making noise.
evidence: At the service door Asha turned the knob with her palm flat against the wood to keep the latch quiet

value.name: exit into back passage
value.description: Asha and the others leave the study one after another and move into the back passage carrying the briefcase.
evidence: they went out one after the other into the back passage with the briefcase held against her ribs
